text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset: pure environment scene for Vicky scene library.
An empty school library with tall cream-painted windows, pale oak shelves and communal study desks, linen pinboard with blank paper, a small stack of closed books, diffused afternoon daylight. Inviting natural seat-level camera, believable ordinary school interior.
Original cinematic location photography for an intimate romance story. Vicky's aesthetic: bright high-key but retained highlight texture; cream white, pale gray, warm natural brown with restrained muted accent color; soft broad frontal/window fill, gentle low-contrast shadows; tactile plaster, wood, linen, glass and stone; very subtle film halation and grain, clean luminous air. Lived-in details without clutter, beautiful but plausible real location rather than showroom CGI. 35-50mm natural perspective, midground environment clearly legible with gently softer far depth. Single full-bleed landscape 1536x1024 image, not a grid.
Strictly environment only: absolutely no people, bodies, faces, hands, silhouettes, distant pedestrians, reflections of people, animals, birds, fish, pets, mannequins, humanoid statues, character artwork or human figures on screens. No watermark, branding or captions. Keep clear usable space for later character compositing. Natural proportions, believable architecture, no fisheye, no excessive HDR, no greasy shine, no orange color cast.
